criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: Three-sentence opener fits within the ~210-char LinkedIn cutoff (192 chars). Names Utqiagvik, a live deployed system, Penn State, and lands the ownership tension immediately. Scorer's unanchored-superlative note was applied post-score: 'most advanced AI' replaced with 'first physics-informed AI digital twin,' which traces directly to verified_findings.

criteria.name: Industry relevance
criteria.notes: All three primary stories localize to Alaska and name a sector consequence: infrastructure/capital-planning (Alaska DOT, North Slope Borough, pipeline operators), real-estate/energy for the STAK/DNR lease, workforce-development capital for NSF TechAccess. HB 381 is a one-line contrast. NSF Alaska entry is framed as possibility, slightly diluting that beat's concreteness.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics every 1 to 2 sentences: Ming Xiao, Dmitry Nicolsky, June 16, two 1-km fiber-optic cables, 10-year window, ADL 422741, June 15, STAK Energy, 715.4 acres, Dalton Highway, 26 miles south of Deadhorse, 50-year lease, NSF 26-508, $224M, 56 hubs, $1M/hub/yr, LOI June 16, proposals July 16, HB 381, six-member conference committee, July 1, June 20.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Permafrost twin backed by Penn State PR plus EurekAlert (two independent credible outlets, high confidence). STAK/DNR uses the official Alaska DNR public notice (primary). NSF cites the official solicitation (primary). HB 381 uses Alaska Public Media. All softening flags respected. Deduction because STAK and NSF are single-primary-sourced at medium confidence.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical and structural. The 'scorecard' device and 'through-line is ownership' are position-taking without hype. Closing 'a sovereignty outcome and a capital outcome, not a press release' is pointed editorial stance. No influencer cadence. Minor edge toward rhetorical cadence in 'sit elsewhere.'

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Paragraphs 2 to 4 sentences. 449 words within 350 to 475. 2905 chars under the 3000 cap. Single bullet block of exactly 3 single-clause items. Scans cleanly on desktop and mobile.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Closes with a real, debatable question naming four actor categories (State, University, ANCs, Outside), tied directly to the ownership tension. No softener, no CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Concrete revisit triggers: DOT/Borough capital planner can act on the digital-twin method; a land/energy exec can track the imminent DNR lease decision on ADL 422741; a UA system or workforce board admin can check NSF 26-508 later rounds.
